title: Games:Edu Track Intro & Keynote: Apprenticeships & the Tacit Knowledge of Game Development
prompt: Build a 'shadowing' simulation mini-game about tacit knowledge transfer in game studios. A senior dev character performs a sequence of actions (shown as glowing gesture icons) and the apprentice player must replicate the sequence from memory — but each round the instructions become slightly less explicit, mimicking how unspoken knowledge fades over remote work. Show a 'knowledge bar' that fills as the apprentice succeeds and depletes when they guess wrong. Clean, warm isometric office illustration style.
